evidence: No recovery executor on tenanos-wave/integration: `git grep -in 'redrive|planRecovery' tenanos-wave/integration -- src/tenanos/` shows only 103's supersede/token-rotation MECHANICS (attemptTransition supersede->STALE, fencing token rotation) — no module plans a redrive, derives a new run identity, or journals a recovery.
P-20260923-095 provides the DECISION vocabulary (REQUEUE_AS_PENDING / RETRY_ATTEMPT_WITH_LINEAGE directives, isLegalTransition NEEDS_RECONCILIATION->PENDING) but no executor that acts on it.
P-20260923-103 provides the CLAIM mechanics (created --claim--> claimed, buildFenceCondition, fencing tokens) but no recovery orchestration.

013 fills the execute gap in the wave's own layering (006=detect, 101=classify/decide, 013=execute): dead-executor predicate (lease expired + grace elapsed, null lease fails closed) + deterministic new run/attempt identity + fresh claim token + journal naming dead executor and new run.

Reference implementation: impl/P-20260923-013/recover.ts + __tests__/recover.test.ts — tsc strict clean, 16/16 jest tests pass. Core properties proved: (1) RESUME-IN-PLACE IMPOSSIBLE — the plan carries no write-target for the old attempt row; new_run_id/new_attempt_id/claim_token are all derived fresh and disjoint from old identities; old ids appear only as supersedes_* lineage and journal old_* fields; (2) RE-ENQUEUE IDEMPOTENT — sha256 domain-separated derivation means the same dead attempt always yields the identical plan, so duplicate recovery passes converge; (3) FAIL-CLOSED — live lease, null lease, or in-grace lease throws AttemptNotDeadError; invalid shapes throw InvalidAttemptError; input never mutated.
notes: Seams at integration: 013 CONSUMES 095 (executes its directives; never reclassifies) and 103 (the fresh claim_token becomes the new attempt row's fencing_token; 103's conditional UPDATE is the atomic-claim enforcer; the old attempt's token is never reused). 013's isDeadExecutor mirrors 006's overdue contract and should delegate to src/tenanos/reconcile/overdue.ts at integration (kept local in the reference impl for self-containment). The recoverer is pure: the data-access layer performs the INSERT + fenced claim. Suggested target: src/tenanos/recovery/recover.ts. No repo commits made by this worker; reference impl only.

overlaps.relation: consumer, not duplicate: 095 owns vocabulary + classifier + transition guard; 013 executes the redrive the classifier decided. NEEDS_RECONCILIATION -> PENDING is a legal 095 edge.
consumer, not duplicate: 103 owns attempt lifecycle mechanics + fencing enforcement; 013 plans the new attempt and its fresh claim token but performs no fenced writes itself.
